title: Hiring Drive Lead Engineer Linux Administration
description:
Job Description: Lead Engineer Linux Administration Job Summary We are looking for a skilled Lead Engineer to manage, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize Linux server infrastructure across on-premises data centers and cloud environments. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) or Rocky Linux, server administration, patch management, automation, monitoring, and infrastructure troubleshooting, along with working knowledge of AWS, Kubernetes, and OpenStack. Key Responsibilities Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade Linux operating systems, primarily Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and Rocky Linux. Perform day-to-day Linux administration, operational support, incident management, and troubleshooting of production and non-production servers. Manage Linux system components, including LVM, file systems, disk partitions, kernel parameters, user and group permissions, SSH, and system services. Troubleshoot complex Linux issues, including performance bottlenecks, CPU and memory utilization, disk I/O, boot failures, kernel-related issues, and system crashes. Configure and manage PXE boot, Kickstart, and automated operating system provisioning. Administer and troubleshoot infrastructure services such as Apache, Nginx, DNS, DHCP, Squid Proxy, and SSL/TLS certificates. Manage configuration automation and infrastructure management using Puppet and Ansible. Perform Linux server patching and vulnerability remediation using tools such as BigFix or ManageEngine. Monitor server health, availability, performance, and capacity using Zabbix monitoring tools. Support Linux infrastructure hosted in on-premises data centers and cloud environments, including AWS and OpenStack. Provide Linux infrastructure support for Kubernetes environments, including node-level troubleshooting, resource utilization, and system-level issues. Develop and maintain Bash and Python scripts to automate routine administration, monitoring, patching, and operational activities. Participate in incident resolution, root cause analysis (RCA), problem management, and preventive maintenance. Follow change management procedures, maintain technical documentation, and ensure compliance with infrastructure security standards. Coordinate with application, network, security, and other infrastructure teams to resolve technical issues and ensure service availability. Participate in planned maintenance activities and provide operational support during scheduled changes and critical incidents. Required Technical Skills Operating Systems: Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky Linux. Linux Administration: LVM, file systems, user and group management, SSH, systemd, kernel troubleshooting, boot processes, and performance tuning. Provisioning: PXE boot, Kickstart, automated OS installation, and server configuration. Web and Network Services: Apache, Nginx, DNS, DHCP, Squid Proxy, SSL/TLS. Automation and Configuration Management: Ansible, Puppet. Cloud and Virtualization: AWS, OpenStack. Container Platforms: Kubernetes fundamentals and Linux node-level troubleshooting. Lead Engineer – Linux Administration Page 1 Patching and Vulnerability Management: BigFix or ManageEngine. Monitoring: Zabbix. Scripting: Bash and Python. Data Center Operations: Hands-on experience supporting on-premises server infrastructure. Desired Qualifications Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 4–7 years of hands-on experience in Linux system administration and infrastructure support. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Experience supporting production environments and handling infrastructure incidents. Good understanding of ITIL processes, incident management, problem management, and change management. Strong communication skills and the ability to coordinate with cross-functional teams. Willingness to participate in scheduled maintenance windows and on-call support, as required. Key Competencies Strong ownership of infrastructure issues and timely incident resolution. Ability to independently handle escalations and drive issues through resolution. Focus on automation, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement. Ability to identify recurring issues and implement permanent solutions. Commitment to infrastructure stability, security, and availability. Lead Engineer – Linux Administration Page 2

Key Skills: Hiring,Python,Linux,Drives,Openstack,Kubernetes,Linux administration,Administration

The candidate will be responsible for hiring recruiters, talent acquisition executives, team leaders, and other internal support staff while ensuring timely closures and a positive candidate experience. title: HR Recruiter
description:
Qualifications 
 Bachelor s Degree : Business Administration (BBA/BS) Human Resource Management (HRM): Focuses on employment law, organizational behavior, and recruitment strategy. Communications / Marketing: Excellent foundation for talent attraction, employer branding, and candidate outreach. Master s Degree : MBA in HR Management will be preferred. 
 
 Job Details 
 Department: Human Resources (HR) Experience Required: 1-2 Years Job Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh Employment Type: Full-Time Work Mode: Work from Office 
 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for a dynamic, confident, and result-oriented HR Recruiter with 1-2 years of experience in recruitment and talent acquisition. The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete recruitment cycle, including understanding hiring requirements, sourcing candidates, screening resumes, conducting initial interviews, coordinating interview schedules, following up with candidates, and supporting the onboarding process. The ideal candidate must have excellent communication skills and strong fluency in English, along with good interpersonal skills, confidence, and the ability to interact professionally with candidates and hiring managers. The candidate should be proactive, organized, target-oriented, and capable of managing multiple job openings simultaneously while ensuring a smooth and positive candidate experience. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 End-to-End Recruitment Manage the complete recruitment process from sourcing candidates to final selection and onboarding. Understand job requirements, job descriptions, and candidate expectations before initiating recruitment. Coordinate with hiring managers and team leaders to understand the skills, qualifications, and experience required for each position. Develop suitable recruitment strategies to attract qualified candidates. Handle multiple job openings simultaneously and prioritize hiring requirements according to business needs. Ensure timely closure of open positions within the expected recruitment timeline. Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the hiring process. Candidate Sourcing Source suitable candidates through various recruitment channels, including: Naukri.com, LinkedIn, Indeed, Foundit, Employee referrals, Social media platforms, Internal candidate databases, Job posting websites and other relevant channels Search for candidates based on job requirements, experience, qualifications, skills, and location preferences. Use appropriate keywords and Boolean searches to identify relevant profiles. Proactively approach potential candidates through calls, emails, and professional networking platforms. Build and maintain a strong candidate pipeline for current and future hiring requirements. Identify suitable candidates for urgent and bulk-hiring requirements whenever needed. Resume Screening and Shortlisting Review resumes and applications received through job portals and other recruitment sources. Evaluate candidates based on educational qualifications, work experience, technical or functional skills, communication abilities, and job suitability. Shortlist relevant profiles according to the companys hiring criteria. Verify basic candidate details, including current location, total experience, relevant experience, current salary, expected salary, notice period, and availability. Identify candidates who meet the minimum job requirements before scheduling interviews. Maintain accurate records of shortlisted, rejected, selected, and pending candidates. Ensure that only suitable and relevant profiles are forwarded to the hiring manager. Initial Telephonic Interviews Conduct initial screening calls with shortlisted candidates. Introduce the company, job role, responsibilities, and employment opportunity professionally. Assess candidates communication skills, confidence, attitude, and overall suitability. Evaluate English-speaking proficiency wherever required for the position. Ask relevant questions regarding previous work experience, job responsibilities, career goals, and reasons for changing jobs. Discuss salary expectations, current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and joining availability. Confirm candidates willingness to work from the office. Identify genuine and interested candidates before forwarding profiles to the next interview stage. Maintain professional communication and provide accurate information about the opportunity. Interview Scheduling and Coordination Coordinate interview schedules between candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers. Arrange telephonic, virtual, and face-to-face interviews as required. Share interview details, including date, time, location, meeting links, and interviewer information. Confirm candidate availability before scheduling interviews. Send timely reminders to candidates before their scheduled interviews. Follow up with candidates and interviewers regarding interview attendance and feedback. Reschedule interviews when necessary and communicate changes promptly. Maintain interview records and update the recruitment tracker regularly. Minimize interview no-shows through proper communication and follow-up. Candidate Follow-Up and Engagement Follow up with candidates at every stage of the recruitment process. Keep candidates informed about interview schedules, feedback, selection status, and next steps. Maintain regular contact with shortlisted and selected candidates. Address candidate queries professionally and provide accurate job-related information. Understand candidate concerns regarding salary, location, work timings, job responsibilities, and joining dates. Ensure candidates remain interested and engaged throughout the hiring process. Follow up with selected candidates until they confirm their joining. Maintain a professional and positive candidate experience, including timely communication with unsuccessful candidates where appropriate. Offer Management and Salary Negotiation Communicate salary expectations and compensation details to the concerned hiring manager. Assist in salary discussions within the approved compensation range. Coordinate the release and communication of offer letters with the authorized HR or recruitment team. Confirm candidates acceptance of offers and expected joining dates. Follow up with offered candidates to reduce offer dropouts. Identify and communicate potential joining risks to the reporting manager. Maintain records of offered, accepted, declined, and pending offers. Escalate compensation-related concerns or special requests for approval. Onboarding Support Coordinate with selected candidates before their joining date. Confirm joining dates and provide necessary joining instructions. Inform candidates about required documents and onboarding formalities.

title: Service Delivery Manager - Talent Acquisition
description:
Service Delivery Manager Talent Acquisition Global Process Owner, Talent Acquisition Operations (R2H) 
 Tower: Recruit to Hire (R2H) Location: Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub) Reports to: HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida Role type: People manager Scope: Requisition management, sourcing support, interview scheduling, offer management, pre-employment checks and onboarding 
 ABOUT THE HUB Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards. 
 ROLE PURPOSE You own the recruitment and onboarding engine for every country moving into Noida. You will replace fragmented local practices with one standard, compliant and fast hiring process. Hiring managers should get the talent they need quickly, and every candidate should get a consistent, high-quality experience. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Transition and shared services set-up Map current recruitment and onboarding practice in each country, including steps, tools, vendors, volumes and cycle times, and set the baseline. Design the R2H target operating model. Define what moves to the hub, what stays with in-country recruiters and business partners, and what goes to vendors or RPO partners. Lead country-by-country transition, covering knowledge transfer, template and offer-letter harmonisation, and stabilisation after cutover. Set up the hub's scheduling, offer and onboarding desks, with capacity models tied to hiring forecasts. 2. Process ownership and service delivery Act as Global Process Owner for R2H. Own the standard process from requisition to day one, including approval rules and local variations. Manage recruitment and background-check vendors across markets. Scorecard them on time-to-fill, quality of hire, diversity and cost. Map the candidate journey from end to end, remove friction points, and lift offer acceptance and employer-brand scores. Deliver a consistent onboarding experience. New joiners should have their systems, equipment and paperwork ready on day one. Act as the escalation point for hiring managers and TA partners on service issues. 3. Governance, risk and controls Work with Legal, Compliance and country HR to keep every step compliant with local labour law, right-to-work rules and data privacy law. Own controls over offer approvals, compensation within band, and the retention and deletion of candidate data. Embed BV's DEI standards in sourcing, shortlisting and vendor contracts, and report on them regularly. 4. Continuous improvement and digital Drive full ATS adoption and automate scheduling, offer generation and e-signature. Introduce AI-enabled tools for screening and scheduling, with fairness and privacy safeguards. Use funnel analytics to find where time is lost, and fix causes at their source. 5. People leadership, performance and culture Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave. Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state. Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings. Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots. Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day. Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers. 
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE First 90 days: TA baseline, R2H operating model and vendor strategy agreed. By go-live: scheduling, offer and onboarding desks live for the first wave of countries. Within 1218 months: measurable cuts in time-to-hire and higher candidate NPS across the regions in scope. 
 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS Time to offer / time to fill: Reduced against the country baseline Offer TAT: 95% Candidate NPS: +40 Hiring manager satisfaction: 4.3 / 5 Day-one readiness: 98% of joiners fully set up Vendor SLA adherence: 95% Cost per hire: Reduced against baseline 
 Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines. 
 TECHNICAL SKILLS End-to-end recruitment operations at volume, including high-volume and multi-country hiring. Management of recruitment vendors, RPO partners and background-screening providers. ATS and onboarding platforms (Workday Recruiting, SuccessFactors RCM/ONB, iCIMS or similar). Candidate experience design, journey mapping and employer-brand metrics. Recruitment compliance covering labour law, right to work and GDPR for candidate data. Recruitment analytics and capacity forecasting. 
 LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES Customer-centric leadership Builds teams from zero Drives change and adoption Sound judgement under pressure Influences without authority across countries Data-led decision making Coaches and develops talent Holds a high bar on control 
 EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS Essential 15+ years in HR, including 8+ years leading talent acquisition operations. Has led a TA transition into shared services or an RPO model. Has managed hiring volumes of 3,000+ per year across several countries. Master's degree in HR, Business or a related field. Preferred Experience in the testing, inspection and certification (TIC), engineering or professional services sectors Lean Six Sigma Green Belt Experience deploying AI recruitment tools 
 KEY STAKEHOLDERS Hub Director, Global TA leadership, hiring managers, country HR, Legal and Compliance, recruitment and screening vendors, IT relevant.

title: Sr. Recruiter Domestic P&C Insurance
description:
Job Title: Sr. Recruiter - Domestic (Insurance PC) Location: Noida (RPO Model) Job Type: Full-Time With Ibu Group Experience: 3+ years in Domestic Recruitment 

 Job Summary 
 We are looking for an experienced Domestic Recruiter to support a Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) engagement for US-based insurance clients. The role involves hiring talent across India for Property Casualty (PC) / General Insurance functions, covering Commercial Lines and Personal Lines, along with insurance technology roles on platforms such as Guidewire and Duck Creek. The ideal candidate will have strong domain hiring experience in PC insurance and a proven track record of delivering for US-headquartered clients, captives or GCCs operating in India. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Manage end-to-end domestic recruitment for PC insurance roles within an RPO delivery model. Source, screen and submit candidates across India for Commercial Lines and Personal Lines functions, including underwriting support, claims, policy servicing, premium audit, actuarial and insurance operations. Hire for insurance technology roles, including Guidewire (Policy Center, Billing Center, Claim Center) and Duck Creek (Policy, Billing, Claims) developers, configurators, integration specialists, BAs and QA professionals. Understand the requirements of US-based clients and map them to the right domain and technical skill sets in the Indian talent market. Coordinate with client hiring managers and stakeholders across time zones to align on priorities and feedback. Schedule and manage interviews between candidates and client panels. Negotiate CTC, manage offers and close candidates efficiently. Maintain accurate candidate data and pipeline reporting in the ATS. Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline of PC insurance professionals for recurring and niche requirements. Use Naukai (Resdex), LinkedIn Recruiter, internal databases, referrals and social media for sourcing. Gather market intelligence on insurance talent availability, compensation benchmarks and competitor hiring in India. Take steps to reduce candidate backouts and improve offer-to-join ratios. Report recruitment metrics to the RPO lead and client stakeholders regularly. Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process. 

 Qualifications 
 3+ years of experience in domestic recruitment, ideally within an RPO setup. At least 2 years of hands-on experience hiring for the Insurance PC / General Insurance domain for US-based clients. Good understanding of Commercial Lines and Personal Lines insurance functions and terminology. Experience hiring for Guidewire and/or Duck Creek technology roles is strongly preferred. Strong command of Naukri (Resdex), LinkedIn Recruiter and Boolean search. Excellent communication, negotiation and closing skills. Ability to handle multiple requirements and deliver under pressure. Experience working with US-based hiring managers or client stakeholders.

 We are looking for proactive and data\-driven Talent Acquisition professionals with 4\+ years of experience to manage end\-to\-end recruitment while bringing analytics and strategic insights to our hiring processes. * Partner with hiring managers to understand talent needs and recommend effective hiring strategies.

* Post and manage job openings on platforms like LinkedIn and Naukri, ensuring timely and accurate updates.
* Maintain and manage recruitment workflows in Greenhouse ATS, ensuring accurate candidate tracking and reporting.
* Track and report recruitment metrics, including time\-to\-hire, cost\-per\-hire, source effectiveness, and candidate pipeline health.
* Analyze recruitment data to identify bottlenecks, trends, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Support workforce planning with insights on talent availability and market trends.

**Required Qualifications:**
* 4\+ years of experience in end\-to\-end recruitment.

* Familiarity with interview design, assessment frameworks, and structured hiring processes.
* Must have worked with Product\-Based companies.


**What We Offer:**
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
* Opportunity to work closely with US leadership and contribute to strategic talent decisions.
* Focus on learning, growth, and ownership.

Candidate Experience Ensure a seamless and professional candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
